name: Moretz's Mountain Apples
tagline: Moretz's Mountain Apples — Boone, NC U
description: In Boone, NC, Moretz's Mountain Apples raises Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, Apples, and Pears on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer and autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
